entries.german: Ruprecht der Jüngste, Pfalzgraf bei Rhein, Herzog in Bayern urkundet, dass er mit Graf Johann von Wertheim überein gekommen ist, dass ihre Leute im Amt Lauda keine Todesfallabgabe entrichten sollen, bis auf Widerruf.
entries.english: Ruprecht der Jüngere, Count Palatine of the Rhine and Duke in Bavaria, records that he has reached an agreement with Count Hans of Wertheim that their people in the Lauda district are not to pay a death duty until further notice.
facts: Eight days after [vogt_zu_Lauda] was killed in a fight in a field near Lauda, this document addresses death duty for the people of Lauda.
The Palatinate and the County of Wertheim exempted their shared subjects in the Amt Lauda from the death duty until further notice.
